market.title: Gwinnett and Forsyth County: October 2026 at a glance
market.source: Realtor.com Economic Research county inventory data
paragraphs: The median listing price in Gwinnett County was $444,495 in October 2026, 1.3% lower than a year earlier, or about $182 per square foot.
Counting pending sales, Forsyth County had 1,564 total listings in October 2026, with a pending ratio of about 0.21. The median listed home was about 3,083 square feet.
The simple version for Gwinnett and Forsyth County: buyers have more homes to compare than they did a year ago, so pricing and condition matter more than ever.
market.verificationNote: Source: Realtor.com Economic Research county inventory data, October 2026 (latest monthly release). Figures are countywide listing data, not closed sales.

rotatingFeatures.label: HOMEOWNER / SEASONAL HOME TIP
rotatingFeatures.title: Brighten Up the Light Fixtures for the Dark Evenings
rotatingFeatures.topic: cleaning the light fixtures before the long evenings
paragraphs: With the sun setting early, the house leans on its lights. Cleaning light fixtures is on UGA Extension's home checklist, and dusty globes can make a room feel dimmer than it needs to.
items: Turn the fixture off and let bulbs cool first.
Remove glass covers carefully and wash them in warm, soapy water.
Dry them fully before putting them back.
rotatingFeatures.closing: It is one of those chores where you can actually see the difference afterward.
rotatingFeatures.source: Source: UGA Cooperative Extension, Home Maintenance Checklist (C1082).
